answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on the widely-used benchmark dataset MMD ... For the text task, we employ the proposed HTR decoder to produce all general responses and intention‑aware responses.

answer_2.quote: Following several previous work, we use Bleu‑n, Nist and Recall@k to evaluate our model over two basic tasks separately, i.e., text task and image task.

answer_4.quote: We hired human experts to score the responses and golden responses in blind review on a scale from 1 to 5 ... The metrics include fluency, relevance, correctness, and informativeness.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters evaluated each generated response on a 1‑5 Likert scale for fluency, relevance, correctness, informativeness, and overall quality.
